do: GuildTraining: local g = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('TheRealGuildmaster'); if g ~= nil then quest:EntityTeleportToThing(quest:GetHero(), g, false) end
note: the Guildmaster WALKS to M_SkillTeacherStand (MoveToPosition) -- teleport onto him wherever he is, then TAB; IsTalkedToByHero -> the SKILL_START cutscene (bow hand-over)
skip the scene, clear the bow item box + TEXT_QST_028_SKILL_INSTRUCTIONS_BOW_PC box; state 2 = shoot 3 targets

do: GuildTraining: local h = quest:GetHero(); local r = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('ArcheryRing'); if r ~= nil and quest:IsDistanceBetweenThingsOver(h, r, 3.0) then quest:EntityTeleportToThing(h, r, false) end; if not quest:IsEntityWieldingRangedWeapon(h) then quest:EntityUnsheatheRangedWeapon(h) end; local ts = quest:GetAllThingsWithScriptName('SkillTarget'); table.sort(ts, function(a, b) return quest:GetDistanceBetweenThings(h, a) < quest:GetDistanceBetweenThings(h, b) end); local n = quest:GetMasterGameState('SkillScore'); local t = ts[(n % 3) + 1] or ts[1]; if t ~= nil then quest:EntitySetFacingAngleTowardsThing(h, t) end
note: static phase: stand IN the ArcheryRing (the 6 m out-of-ring check DISQUALIFIES), make sure the bow is drawn (IsEntityWieldingRangedWeapon / EntityUnsheatheRangedWeapon -- a keyboard E is swallowed by boxes), face + ranged-target the (score mod 3)-th nearest SkillTarget (a hit dummy goes non-targetable; each static hit is retail's +1, 1/3..3/3), 1.5 s draw and release; 3/3 -> the SKILL_MOVE cutscene (verified by hand 2026-09-21) -- run 4: a teleport onto the ring EVERY shot cancelled the release (bow drawn, score 0); now only when >3 m from the ring, and the SPACE lock after facing (the hand-run recipe)

let SKILL_MOVE play (no `skip`: an ESC landing after the scene's end opened the pause menu and froze the channel, run 4); click the first-person-aim tutorial box; the moving round (10 arrows, 51 s) starts when the boxes are cleared -- the cutscene re-sheathes the bow
